facts.fact: Sudan's Ministry of Digital Transformation and Communications and the Central Bank of Sudan were finalising the integration of SudaPass with the banking sector for eKYC, so banks can verify customers digitally, and banks will begin once processes are complete, each rolling out by its own readiness (as_of is the document's published date; it says the announcement was made recently).
